novel_features.name: Money-window default
novel_features.description: schedule_a queries pair committee + two-year period so bare lookups return live recent money instead of the upstream 504 the API returns for unfiltered schedule_a scans; sort defaults to contribution_receipt_date.
novel_features.rationale: The API's most common journalist query works on the first try with no param archaeology.

novel_features.name: Donor-first search flow
novel_features.description: One name query fans out to candidate and committee matches, giving the FEC ID needed by schedules/totals in a single call before any money lookup.
novel_features.rationale: Every workflow starts 'who is this person and what is their ID'; the CLI front-loads it.

novel_features.name: Efile live feed
novel_features.description: Real-time electronic filings window for contributions as they post, separate from processed paper data.
novel_features.rationale: Nightly bulk vs realtime efile distinction surfaced directly as commands.
